snippet.title: Hollow Knight – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition – Nintendo Direct: Partner Showcase 2.5.2026
snippet.description:
Hollow Knight – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition is available today: 
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/hollow-knight-nintendo-switch-2-edition-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Explore twisting caverns, battle tainted creatures and solve ancient mysteries in this classically styled 2D action adventure! Enjoy higher resolution, improved frame rates, additional effects, and more.
 
#HollowKnight #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoDirect
